violation_type.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training
violation_type.typical_finding: Recited: Four out of five staff files did not have the 24-hour pre-service training available for review.

finding_variants.text: Recited: Four out of five staff files did not have the 24-hour pre-service training available for review.
Of the four personnel records evaluated, one has not completed 24 clock hours of training within 90 days of being hired.
There was 1 staff member who did  not meet the 24 hour requirement for pre-service training.  A total of 20 hours was received within the first 90 days of employment.
One new employee hired 6/24/24 was left alone with children but has not completed at leat 8 hours of preservice traiing.
Recite: A caregiver hired on 2/20/23 did not have the 24 hours of Pre-Service trainings completed.

During a DFPS investigation, it was found that multiple employees were not trained before being placed in a classroom with children. It was also found that a caregiver who had not worked in childcare for about 8 years did not receive training prior to being placed in the classroom.
